capabilities.description: Track current stock quantities and product details for all SKUs in the shop.
Notify staff when product quantities fall below configurable thresholds.
Manage user accounts and roles for shop employees.
Provide a dashboard with real-time inventory metrics and visual summaries.
Support manual stock adjustments with an approval workflow and audit trail.

summary: A lightweight inventory tracking application for tiny smoke retail shops, enabling owners to manage products, monitor stock levels, and receive low-stock alerts. Designed for small teams and single-location retailers who need a simple, reliable tool without enterprise complexity.
